To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
15-mm cuts, pre-dried at 40 ° C for 120 min are best for nutritional quality while the 20-mm cut, without pre-drying, are best for sensory quality.
the 15-mm beef chunks pre-dried at 40 ° C for 120 min are best suited for deep-frying and commercialization in Kenya’s meat sector.

the 15-mm chunks, pre-dried at 40 ° C for 120 min and deep-fried at 170 ° C for 10 min had the best nutritional quality while the 20-mm cut chunks that have not undergone pre-drying and deep-frying had the best sensory attributes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the standardization of beef chunks for deep-fried meat products in Kenya’s meat processing industry.
the standardization of the size of the beef chunks for deep-fried meat products.

the development of a standardized deep-fried meat product from the pastoral regions of Kenya and sub-Saharan Africa in general, with the aim of improving the product quality and making it mainstream into the meat industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 15-mm chunk pre-dried for at least 120 min would be the best in both sensory and nutritional qualities.
the 15-mm chunks that have been pre-dried for the longest time would be most suitable for commercialization.
the 15-mm chunks pre-dried for a minimum of 120 min would be the most appropriate for mainstreaming of this product into the meat industry in Kenya.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 20 mm cut size without pre-drying is best suited to the consumer while 15 mm cut size pre-dried for at least 120 min would be best suited to the processor.
the 15-mm chunk, pre-dried at 40 ° C for 120 min and then fried at 170 ° C for 10 min would be the best suited product for the commercialization.
the 15-mm chunks pre-dried for one hour would be best for commercial production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the size of cut has a significant effect on the quality and acceptability of the product.
standardization of beef cuts for deep-fried meat products is possible and that it should be based on both sensory and nutritional attributes of the products.
the size of cut, pre-drying time and sensory acceptability are important parameters in the processing of deep-fried meat products.
